phase_name: T99 Removal & ID=0 Staging Architecture Revision

key_architectural_specifications.primary_identity: 96-bit STM32 Hardware UID at 0x1FFF7590 (24-char upper-case hex string UID24)

dual_state_on_id_0.state_0x00_uncommissioned: Responds to T0:DISCOVER via CRC16 slotted backoff (25ms slot width)
dual_state_on_id_0.state_0x01_staging: MUST IGNORE T0:DISCOVER broadcasts! Listens strictly to targeted unicast T0:...:<UID24>
dual_state_on_id_0.state_0x02_active: Operational node (ID 1..10). Rejects direct ASSIGN_ID unless preceded by STAGE_ID or RESET_ID

key_architectural_specifications.atomic_3_way_swap_sequence: Node A (ID 2) -> ID 0 STAGING (RAM only) -> Node B (ID 4) -> ID 2 ACTIVE (Flash Page 127) -> Node A (ID 0 STAGING) -> ID 4 ACTIVE (Flash Page 127)
key_architectural_specifications.recovery_mechanism: ESP32 NVS Write-Ahead Logging (eagle_prov_wal) + 10s Staging Auto-Timeout Rollback to Flash ID
key_architectural_specifications.security: Nextion Service Menu PIN/HMAC authorization + dual-layer SYS_MODE_RUNNING interlock
